_comment: Cross-language equivalence fixture (Skeptic Minor 2 on PR #730, extended round-3 for the failure paths per Skeptic Minor 1): exercised by BOTH hooks/tests/test-overreach-detector.js and bin/tests/test_ds_measure_conductor_tool_calls.py, asserting byte-identical output from the JS detector (hooks/lib/overreach-detector.js) and the Python calibrator (bin/ds-measure-conductor-tool-calls) against the SAME transcripts. Each entry in `cases` is either `lines` (structured message objects, JSON-stringified one per JSONL line by the consumer) OR `raw_lines` (literal text written verbatim, one per line, for a genuinely malformed transcript) - never both.

cases.name: interleaved-non-agent-results
cases._comment: Encodes the Critical-2 regression directly: three investigation calls (Read, Bash cat, Read) occur BEFORE any subagent spawn, each with its own (non-Agent) tool_result. Under the pre-fix bug (the post-spawn spot-check window reset on ANY tool_result, not just an Agent-tool's own result), the second and third calls were incorrectly whitelisted as 'post-spawn spot-checks' even though no spawn had happened yet. The fixture then adds a real Agent spawn (tool_use id agent-1) and its own tool_result (opens the window correctly), followed by two Read calls inside the 2-call spot-check window (correctly whitelisted) and a third Read call outside it (correctly counted), each separated by a NON-Agent tool_result that must not touch the window.

cases.name: empty-transcript
cases._comment: Skeptic round-3 Minor 1: a genuinely empty transcript file (zero lines) must be reported as unavailable/unreadable in BOTH languages, never folded into the zero-spawn population as a real zero-call session.

cases.name: malformed-transcript
cases._comment: Skeptic round-3 Minor 1: a transcript file containing only non-JSON garbage lines must also be reported as unavailable/unreadable in BOTH languages - zero parsed records, not zero calls.
raw_lines: {"this": "parses as JSON but has no message.content array"}
